<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL"
                  xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance"
                  id="Definitions_TicketBooking"
                  targetNamespace="http://example.com/bpmn/ticket-booking">
  <bpmn:message id="Message_BookingRequest" name="Booking request with personal and payment details"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_Ticket" name="Ticket"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_Reminder" name="Check-in or boarding reminders and instructions"/>

  <bpmn:collaboration id="Collaboration_TicketBooking">
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Customer" name="Customer" processRef="Process_Customer"/>
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_TravelCompany" name="Travel company" processRef="Process_TravelCompany"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_BookingRequest"
                      name="Booking request"
                      sourceRef="Task_SendBookingRequest"
                      targetRef="StartEvent_BookingRequest"
                      messageRef="Message_BookingRequest"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_Ticket"
                      name="Ticket"
                      sourceRef="Task_SendTicket"
                      targetRef="Task_ReceiveTicket"
                      messageRef="Message_Ticket"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_Reminder"
                      name="Reminders and instructions"
                      sourceRef="Task_SendReminder"
                      targetRef="Participant_Customer"
                      messageRef="Message_Reminder"/>
  </bpmn:collaboration>

  <bpmn:process id="Process_Customer" name="Customer ticket booking and journey" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="StartEvent_Customer"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_SearchTicket" name="Search for a flight, train, or bus ticket"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_SelectRoute" name="Select preferred route, date, and time"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_ProvideDetails" name="Provide personal information and payment details"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_SendBookingRequest" name="Submit booking request" messageRef="Message_BookingRequest"/>
    <bpmn:receiveTask id="Task_ReceiveTicket" name="Receive ticket" messageRef="Message_Ticket"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_CompleteJourney" name="Complete journey"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_PostTravel" name="Post-travel feedback or services?"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_PostTravel" name="Provide post-travel feedback or use post-travel services"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_JourneyComplete" name="Journey complete"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_PostTravelComplete" name="Post-travel activity complete"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Customer_1" sourceRef="StartEvent_Customer" targetRef="Task_SearchTicket"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Customer_2" sourceRef="Task_SearchTicket" targetRef="Task_SelectRoute"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Customer_3" sourceRef="Task_SelectRoute" targetRef="Task_ProvideDetails"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Customer_4" sourceRef="Task_ProvideDetails" targetRef="Task_SendBookingRequest"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Customer_5" sourceRef="Task_SendBookingRequest" targetRef="Task_ReceiveTicket"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Customer_6" sourceRef="Task_ReceiveTicket" targetRef="Task_CompleteJourney"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Customer_7" sourceRef="Task_CompleteJourney" targetRef="Gateway_PostTravel"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_PostTravel_Yes" name="Feedback or services pursued" sourceRef="Gateway_PostTravel" targetRef="Task_PostTravel">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">postTravelActivityPursued = true</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_PostTravel_No" name="No further activity" sourceRef="Gateway_PostTravel" targetRef="EndEvent_JourneyComplete"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_PostTravel_End" sourceRef="Task_PostTravel" targetRef="EndEvent_PostTravelComplete"/>
  </bpmn:process>

  <bpmn:process id="Process_TravelCompany" name="Travel company booking processing" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:laneSet id="LaneSet_TravelCompany">
      <bpmn:lane id="Lane_BookingSystem" name="Booking system">
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>StartEvent_BookingRequest</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_ProcessingSplit</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_GenerateTicket</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_ProcessingJoin</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_SendTicket</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_ReminderDecision</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_ReminderMerge</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>EndEvent_BookingComplete</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
      <bpmn:lane id="Lane_TravelCompany" name="Travel company">
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_UpdateInventory</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_SendReminder</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
    </bpmn:laneSet>

    <bpmn:startEvent id="StartEvent_BookingRequest" name="Booking request received">
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MessageEventDefinition_BookingRequest" messageRef="Message_BookingRequest"/>
    </bpmn:startEvent>
    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_ProcessingSplit" name="Process booking and inventory"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_GenerateTicket" name="Generate ticket"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_UpdateInventory" name="Update seat inventory"/>
    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_ProcessingJoin" name="Ticket and inventory updated"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_SendTicket" name="Send ticket to customer" messageRef="Message_Ticket"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_ReminderDecision" name="Send reminders or instructions?"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_SendReminder" name="Send check-in or boarding reminders and instructions" messageRef="Message_Reminder"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_ReminderMerge" name="Continue after reminder decision"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_BookingComplete" name="Booking processing complete"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Company_1" sourceRef="StartEvent_BookingRequest" targetRef="Gateway_ProcessingSplit"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Company_2" sourceRef="Gateway_ProcessingSplit" targetRef="Task_GenerateTicket"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Company_3" sourceRef="Gateway_ProcessingSplit" targetRef="Task_UpdateInventory"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Company_4" sourceRef="Task_GenerateTicket" targetRef="Gateway_ProcessingJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Company_5" sourceRef="Task_UpdateInventory" targetRef="Gateway_ProcessingJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Company_6" sourceRef="Gateway_ProcessingJoin" targetRef="Task_SendTicket"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Company_7" sourceRef="Task_SendTicket" targetRef="Gateway_ReminderDecision"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Reminder_Yes" name="Reminders or instructions sent" sourceRef="Gateway_ReminderDecision" targetRef="Task_SendReminder">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">remindersOrInstructionsSent = true</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Reminder_No" name="No reminders or instructions" sourceRef="Gateway_ReminderDecision" targetRef="Gateway_ReminderMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Reminder_Continue" sourceRef="Task_SendReminder" targetRef="Gateway_ReminderMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Company_8" sourceRef="Gateway_ReminderMerge" targetRef="EndEvent_BookingComplete"/>
  </bpmn:process>
</bpmn:definitions>
